description: REMOVES A SAVED REPORT FROM THE EXTENSION — the row and the document together, because an index that forgets an entry while the megabytes stay is a leak nobody finds. It touches nothing on the page and nothing on disk: a file you already wrote with `out` is yours and stays. The reply lists what is left.

tabId.description: Target tab (from qa_tabs); omit for the active tab

name: qa_report_drop
title: Forget one saved report
